_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform. ISO 10303-214 CC1 (config data only) is a validation-gated dialect over the SAME StepSnapshot the ✳️any subset owns, so it shares the snapshot type — but NOT the vocabulary: ✳️any declares the ISO 10303-21 grammar (insert-entity, set-entity-arg, …), while this catalog declares one kind per axis `check_cc1_conformance` actually reads. CC1 admits no *_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION at all, so its ladder verb is `remove-shape-representation` and it owns no verb that could write one; against the real committed export both representations (#13 at rung 6 and #836 at rung 2) are above its ceiling. The ladder classification the oracle uses is re-derived from ISO 10303-214 §4.3 in ../../../🦀️oracle.rs, shared by all seven ap214 subsets so no class copies it, and never called out of the production `engine::ladder` — an oracle that asked the code under test how to classify would compare an implementation with itself.

oracles.rationale: ruststep 0.4 is the real, independent ISO 10303-21 READER for this subset: `ast::Exchange::from_str` parses the real committed `📐️hexagonal-cut-concrete-forest-left-ap214.stp` (a genuine Rhino 8.31 / ST-Developer v19.2 export, 1,396 real entities) with zero errors, and it is what reads back every result this subset's oracle produces before `semantic-step-conformance-class-v1` compares it. It has NO writer at all (`ast::ser::to_record` only builds an in-memory `Record` from an already-typed struct; no `Display`/`fmt::Formatter` impl exists on `Exchange`/`DataSection`/`Record`/`Parameter`), so per the fleet brief's §6 nothing in this case is typed `@mode-differential` — ruststep cannot be a second PRODUCER of mutated bytes. The re-serializer is this standard's own from-scratch Part-21 writer in ../../../🦀️oracle.rs, deliberately independent of this repository's production `step::engine::part21` writer. What the evidence therefore is, stated plainly: a real third-party parse of the conformance-relevant STRUCTURE of every result — the ladder census, the declared schema and the product identity chain — plus the inverse and identity laws asserted in role, not a byte-level differential claim.

comparisonProfiles.description: STEP AP214 exchange structures compared by what a CONFORMANCE CLASS is about, and by nothing else: the declared FILE_SCHEMA, the full *_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION ladder census (id, type name, ISO 10303-214 §4.3 rung), whether the document sits inside the class's ceiling, the count of instances above it, the PRODUCT/formation/definition identity chain, and the instance count. Deliberately NOT the ✳️any subset's whole id-keyed entity graph — 1,396 entities of unrelated real geometry would drown every class-level difference this profile exists to see. Header timestamp, preprocessor and originating-system strings and line wrapping are writer freedom. Declared once, here, for all six ✳️ccN subsets: the registry merges every discovered manifest repo-wide, so declaring it six times would be the copy this arrangement exists to avoid.
